pos_orders.name: pos_orders
pos_orders.about: One row per sale made at the POS (offline: booths, bazaars, shop). Business facts live here, not in the website/Shopee/Lazada data.
pos_orders.columns: id, client_uuid, subtotal, discount, total (PHP; subtotal = total + discount), oversold (bool: sold more than on hand), device_id, payment_method (cash, gcash, card, maya; null = legacy cash), customer_handle, status (completed or voided), remarks, created_at, edited_at (null = never edited), event_id (null = not tagged to an event), pet_type (dog, cat, both, null = untagged).
pos_orders.prefer: pos_orders_completed for sales; this table for voided rows.
pos_orders.testOrders: UNKNOWN: no marker found in code (status is only completed or voided; device_id is never written).

pos_orders_completed.name: pos_orders_completed
pos_orders_completed.about: Ask Coop default view: completed orders, the same sales the dashboard counts (every status except voided, a null status included; in practice completed); there is no test-order marker, so test orders are not separated.

pos_order_items.name: pos_order_items
pos_order_items.about: One row per order line. A bundle sale is a header line (bundle_id set, product_id null, paid price in line_total) plus pick lines (same bundle_group, unit_price and line_total = 0). Counting both double-counts units and revenue.
pos_order_items.columns: id, order_id, product_id (SKU), bundle_id, bundle_group, qty, unit_price, line_total.

pos_products.name: pos_products
pos_products.about: Product catalogue (SKU master). Stock is NOT on this table.
pos_products.columns: product_id, name, product_line (FDR / JRK / MEAT, Coop's SKU-decode line), category (POS display tab), subcategory (Freeze-Dried only), emoji, active (listed or unlisted), updated_at.

pos_prices.name: pos_prices
pos_prices.columns: product_id, price (PHP). currency, updated_by, updated_at exist only in the local fixture.

pos_price_changes.name: pos_price_changes
pos_price_changes.columns: id, product_id, old_price, new_price, changed_at; reason, changed_by, device_id known only from the fixture.

pos_bundles.name: pos_bundles
pos_bundles.about: Bundle definitions. bundle_type is fixed (set contents in pos_bundle_items) or pick ("Buy Any N": pick_count picks from line_categories).
pos_bundles.columns: bundle_id, name, price, active, bundle_type, pick_count, line_categories (text[]), emoji, updated_at.

pos_bundle_items.name: pos_bundle_items
pos_bundle_items.columns: id, bundle_id, product_id, qty. PII: no. Writes: RPC apply_pos_bundle (assumed; not verified). Reads: src/pos-data.ts. Freshness: live.

pos_events.name: pos_events
pos_events.about: Bazaars and markets the POS ran.
pos_events.columns: event_id, name, venue, city, organizer, starts_on, ends_on (date; null = single day, treat as starts_on), opening_cash (float at open), cash_note, closing_cash (counted at close), status (active or closed), created_by, created_at, updated_at.

pos_order_prizes.name: pos_order_prizes
pos_order_prizes.about: Free items won (spin-the-wheel prizes) and attached to an order.
pos_order_prizes.columns: id, client_uuid, product_id, qty, oversold, note, won_at, voided_at (null = active), plus an order link read as pos_orders(client_uuid, customer_handle, created_at) (the FK column name is not shown in code).

pos_free_tastes.name: pos_free_tastes
pos_free_tastes.about: Stock opened for pets to sample (free tastes), not sold.
pos_free_tastes.columns: id, client_uuid, product_id, qty, oversold, opened_at, voided_at (null = active); note, created_by, device_id are sent on write (src/pos-free-taste-actions.ts) but never read back.

pos_inventory.name: pos_inventory
pos_inventory.about: Current on-hand per product (a view, per the system overview).
pos_inventory.columns: product_id, stock (units), next_expiry (earliest expiry that still has stock, date).

pos_inventory_by_location.name: pos_inventory_by_location
pos_inventory_by_location.about: On-hand per product per location (a view grouped by product_id, location).
pos_inventory_by_location.columns: product_id, location (office or event as read by code), stock.
pos_inventory_by_location.prefer: coop_explore_stock_event for sellable stock (the Event location); this table for a named location.

pos_inventory_lots.name: pos_inventory_lots
pos_inventory_lots.about: Stock lots (batches) with expiry. Source of truth under the two views above.
pos_inventory_lots.columns: lot_id, product_id, location, lot_code ('opening', 'adjust' or a supplier code), expires_on, qty_received, qty_on_hand, received_at, updated_at. FEFO: stock is consumed by earliest expires_on first.

pos_stock_movements.name: pos_stock_movements
pos_stock_movements.about: Append-only stock ledger. Signed delta (sales negative).
pos_stock_movements.columns: id, product_id, delta, reason, created_by, created_at; the RPC body also writes lot_id, location, order_id. Reason values seen in code: sale, receipt (intake), add-void (undo of an intake), recount. Other reasons (transfer, prize, taste, void restock) are not confirmed.

pos_locations.name: pos_locations
pos_locations.about: Location master. Referenced only by supabase/set_stock_location.sql (select 1 from pos_locations where code = p_location).

pos_settings.name: pos_settings
pos_settings.about: Key/value config store shared by zoomy-pos, the UI and the backend.

pos_stock_alert_log.name: pos_stock_alert_log
pos_stock_alert_log.about: Low-stock alert state (fire on crossing, resolve on recovery).
pos_stock_alert_log.columns: id, product_id, level_at_fire (low or out), stock_at_fire, fired_at, resolved_at (null = open).

spin_wheel_leads.name: spin_wheel_leads
spin_wheel_leads.about: Spin-the-wheel sign-ups collected at booths. Imported by hand from CSV; no key to orders or events.
spin_wheel_leads.columns: lead_id, email (nullable since v2), mobile, prize, campaign (admin event slug such as modern-market-sept2026; a hint, not a key), collected_at, consent_at (never surfaced by the UI), created_at, instagram (lowercase, no @), pet (free text such as "Mimi / Puspin").

lazada_orders.name: lazada_orders
lazada_orders.columns: order_item_id, order_number, ordered_at, status, customer_name, city, phone (not null; the buyer key), item_name, variation, paid_price, shipping_fee, pay_method, uploaded_at. Contacts are rolled up by phone at read time, never stored.

lazada_uploads.name: lazada_uploads
lazada_uploads.columns: id, uploaded_at, file_name, rows_read, items_saved, buyers, skipped_status, skipped_phone, skipped_date, skipped_id, excluded_buyers.

digest_archive.name: digest_archive
digest_archive.about: One archived digest per run of a window; windows vary (weekly, about a month, rolling 30 days) (the synthesized DigestDocument, plus the retrieval bundle it was built from).
digest_archive.columns: id, window_from, window_to (timestamptz), digest (jsonb DigestDocument, mirrored in src/types.ts), created_at; the bundle column is not for Ask Coop.

business_health.name: business_health
business_health.about: Per-channel facts snapshot used to compute QRR (quality-of-revenue ratio) live in the UI.
business_health.columns: id, window_from, window_to (date), snapshot (jsonb BusinessHealthSnapshot: window, target, perChannel[] of orders / buyers / revenue / adSpend / adRevenue / platformFeeApplies / default knobs, monthly[], cohorts, buyerMix, computedAt), computed_at.

marketplace_price_changes.name: marketplace_price_changes
marketplace_price_changes.about: Append-only audit of every repricer decision (Shopify price set about 15% under the Lazada/Shopee reference).
marketplace_price_changes.columns: run_id (uuid), ran_at, dry_run, applied, marketplace ('lazada' in the DDL comment), marketplace_sku, marketplace_title, reference_price, reference_source (price | special_price), listed_price, special_price, shopify_variant_id, shopify_title, match_score, match_band (exact | auto | review | none | ambiguous), target_price, floor_price, old_price, new_price (null = nothing written), guardrail (no-floor | floor-clamp | max-change-clamp | no-op), skip_reason (listing-inactive | sku-inactive | no-reference-price | unmatched | needs-review | ambiguous), captured_at, note.

marketplace_tokens.name: marketplace_tokens
marketplace_tokens.about: NEVER EXPOSE. Holds the Lazada access and refresh tokens.
marketplace_tokens.columns: marketplace, access_token, refresh_token, obtained_at (ms epoch), expires_in (s), refresh_expires_in (s), updated_at.

coop_reports.name: coop_reports
coop_reports.about: Saved Ask Coop reports: one row per report (title, owner, team or private, pinned, soft delete).
coop_reports.columns: id, owner_email, title (1 to 120 chars), visibility (team | private), pinned, current_version, deleted_at (soft delete), created_at, updated_at.

coop_report_versions.name: coop_report_versions
coop_report_versions.about: - Writes/reads: src/reports-actions.ts, src/reports-data.ts. Ask Coop: direct read (read only; never writes). Verified: DDL.
coop_report_versions.columns: report_id (FK to coop_reports.id), version, spec_version, spec (jsonb under 32 KB), source_prompt (max 2000 chars, never fed to a model), created_by, created_at.

company_users.name: company_users
company_users.columns: id, company_id, user_email, role (enum company_role: coop_admin, company_admin, analyst, store_manager), store_scope (text[]; null = all), status (active | invited | suspended), created_at.

pos_dashboard_users.name: pos_dashboard_users
pos_dashboard_users.about: Everyone who signed in to the dashboard; the recipients of low-stock emails.

coop_explore_drift_log.name: coop_explore_drift_log
coop_explore_drift_log.about: read-only view over coop_explore_admin.record_drift(), pg_cron job coop_explore_drift daily 22:00 UTC (06:00 PH), kept 90 days
